stages.name: Observe
stages.instruction: Drag the voltmeter across any dipole to measure the voltage $U$. Click the switch to break or close the loop and watch how each $U$ changes.
stages.concept: The voltage between two points is a difference of potential: $U_{AB} = V_A - V_B$. It is measured in volts $(V)$ by a voltmeter placed in parallel with the dipole.

stages.name: Experiment
stages.instruction: Use the voltmeter to reach every target reading listed. Toggle the switch when a target asks for the open-loop case.
stages.concept: Around any closed loop the signed voltages sum to zero: $\Sigma U = 0$. An open switch drops the full source voltage; a closed switch drops $0\,V$.

stages.name: Evaluate
stages.instruction: Three voltages are labeled. The fourth is hidden. Pick the instrument that measures voltage and place it across the missing dipole. One attempt.
stages.concept: Apply $\Sigma U = 0$ on the loop to work out the unknown $U$ on paper. Only a voltmeter placed in parallel with the correct dipole verifies it.

labels.tip1: drag the voltmeter onto any dipole; click the switch to open/close
labels.tip2: hit every target — read the value shown on the voltmeter body
labels.tip3: reason on paper; the reading stays hidden until you commit
labels.peek_tip: KVL: around the closed loop the signed voltages sum to zero. Identify the missing dipole and compute U before placing the probe.

1.1: Drag the voltmeter from the palette onto one of the four dipole positions in the loop.
1.2: A voltmeter measures U = V_A - V_B between two nodes. Try measuring across the battery, then across a lamp.
1.3: Now click the switch to open it. Measure across the open switch — you should read the full source voltage.

2.1: Read every target line. Each asks for U across a specific dipole, sometimes with the switch open.
2.2: Move the voltmeter from one dipole to another; the reading updates instantly.
2.3: Open switch → lamps read 0 V and the switch itself reads the full E. Closed switch → the reverse.

3.1: Only one of the three palette items is an instrument that measures voltage. Which one?
3.2: The unknown U satisfies E - U_L1 - U_L2 - U_switch = 0 around the loop.
3.3: Solve for the missing U, identify which dipole it belongs to, then place the voltmeter in parallel with that dipole.
